name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives an AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers what you built and decided yesterday instead of starting from zero every time you open it.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team using AI coding assistants daily who is sick of re-explaining their codebase and decisions every single session.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools startup builds a hosted, team-shared version so a whole company's AI agents share project memory and institutional knowledge.
An agency running many client projects through AI coding assistants uses it to keep each client's context cleanly separated and never re-explained.
A 'managed AI dev environment' service bundles this plus other agent tooling and sells it as a monthly seat to small dev teams.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted cloud-sync tier that stores and shares agent memory across a team's machines, billed per seat.
One-off setup/integration service for companies rolling this out across their engineering org.

steal_this: Build a thin hosted wrapper this weekend: a $9/month 'team memory sync' service on top of the open-source tool for small dev teams who don't want to self-host.
